id_mapping_warning: ID mapping check: this workbook contains explicit Stage1_Test customer_id values; they are used directly, verified unique, disjoint from train, and present in Stage2_Data.

top_ten_pool_sensitivity.purpose: robustness-only rank-10/rank-11 swap; never used for model/selection choice

exact.decoding: left-to-right bit i corresponds to top-10 rank i+1 and that row's customer_id

qubo.alternative_status: 20-qubit slack QUBO retained as an alternative encoding; its penalty minimum is checked against the exact subset optimum.
qubo.constraint_encoding: Exactly-K uses penalty*(sum(x)-K)^2. Each <= resource limit uses penalty*(sum(resource_i*x_i)+binary_slack-limit)^2; binary slack bits represent 0 through the limit.

qaoa.backend: Qiskit AerSimulator for final shots; vectorized exact statevector objective during optimization
qaoa.normalization: net value coefficients divided by max(abs(net value coefficient))
qaoa.initial_state: uniform Dicke state over all weight-6 bitstrings
qaoa.mixer: complete-graph XY mixer using sequential RXX(beta) then RYY(beta) on each pair; preserves Hamming weight
qaoa.constraint_handling: decode decision bits, then post-select/check K, workbook budget, and workbook capacity; no slack qubits

best_of_80_measured_runs.threshold_definition: at least 10% optimum probability mass per 8192-shot run

qaoa.submitted_selection: exact feasible optimum (brute force over all subsets)

transpilation_diagnostics.backend: Qiskit AerSimulator with a linear coupling map (simulated topology, not an IBM device)
transpilation_diagnostics.note: Transpiled the exact persisted parameters from the best-of-80 measured run; this is a diagnostic, not a new QAOA score or hardware run.
